goal: Defeat Team Rocket in Silph Co.

subgoals.goal_text: Travel from Cerulean City to Saffron City via Route 5.
Enter the Silph Co. building in Saffron City.
Fight through the first floor of Silph Co. to reach the elevator.
Fight through the second floor of Silph Co. and return to the elevator.
Fight through the third floor of Silph Co. and return to the elevator.
Fight through the fourth floor of Silph Co. and return to the elevator.
Fight through the fifth floor of Silph Co. and return to the elevator.
Use the elevator to reach the top floor (11F) and find Giovanni.
Defeat Giovanni in the final battle at Silph Co.
